subject.title: refactor(qa): remove execution and Matrix profiles

question: Should legacy `openclaw qa matrix --profile <name>` commands be allowed to change silently into root state-directory profile selection, or should the retired Matrix-specific form receive a migration error?
rationale: The branch intentionally removes the Matrix profile vocabulary, but root parsing still assigns `--profile` a valid different meaning; only maintainers can decide whether immediate beta/source-checkout retirement justifies that silent semantic change.

options.title: Approve immediate retirement
options.body: Keep the profile-free design and accept that old Matrix commands must remove `--profile` and use repeated `--scenario` when narrowing selection.

options.title: Add a migration error
options.body: Detect the legacy Matrix command form before root parsing and direct operators to the catalog-selected command and repeated `--scenario` flags.

options.title: Pause for caller audit
options.body: Hold the refactor until maintainers confirm there are no supported external reusable-workflow callers or documented legacy Matrix invocations to preserve.

recommendation.title: Approve immediate retirement
recommendation.body: Keep the profile-free design and accept that old Matrix commands must remove `--profile` and use repeated `--scenario` when narrowing selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The current QA refactor author recorded the intended retirement boundary and is the clearest available routing contact in the supplied history.
